info.name: Mink (Race)
info.description: A small, sleek mustelid folk—quick, clever, and quietly telepathic.
info.author: eddiefscott

description.p: Sleek and restless, mink folk skim riverbanks and city canals alike. Their whiskers twitch at hidden currents—of both water and thought.
Your Dexterity increases by 3, your Intelligence increases by 1, and your Strength decreases by 3.
Your walking speed is 30 feet, and you have a swim speed of 30 feet.

You can communicate telepathically with a creature you can see within 30 feet of you. The creature must understand at least one language. You don’t need to share a language with it, and it can reply to you telepathically (no action required) while it is within range.
You have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.
You can move through the space of any creature that is Medium or larger.
You have proficiency in the Stealth skill.
You can speak, read, and write Common and one additional language of your choice.

sheet.description: DEX +3, INT +1, STR –3; Small; walk 30 ft, swim 30 ft; telepathy 30 ft (two-way); Keen Scent (adv. Perception by smell); Nimbleness (move through larger creatures); Stealth proficiency.
